test_title: PYST 33 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

His style of speaking was marked by extreme ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'grandiloquence.'**
 
• **Grandiloquence** is a noun that means "pompous or extravagant language, style, or manner, especially in a way that is intended to impress." **(भाषा या शैली की भव्यता)**
